scope.label: adapter
scope.meaning: Bijective base three encodes all Object[] inputs of zero to three cells, low digit first: null, String A, boxed Integer 1. Every destination is a fresh String[] initially filled with x. State encodes the final x/null/A cells in base three for the known length, after either exit. Thrown covers exactly ArrayStoreException.
